description: An agent that makes claims from fragmented sources, admits when it is wrong, and refuses the same mistake next time.
architecture: Orchestrated multi-agent pipeline: Aggregator, Claim, Confessor and Judge agents with shared H-MEM memory

sponsor_technology.zetaris: Data layer: every bundle is one SQL query over the Zetaris REST API against alea.alea_readings
sponsor_technology.meterless_engine: H-MEM stores confessions and recalls the rules that trigger refusals; tested in test/cycle.test.ts
sponsor_technology.meterless_nightshift: Primary and only AI provider (OpenAI-compatible Runtime)
sponsor_technology.nvidia: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b via Nightshift writes rationales and confessions and reviews every draft as the Judge; model logged per step
sponsor_technology.cursor: Used Cursor's agent to diagnose Nightshift 502s (Nemotron empty responses), fix them (thinking off, max_tokens 4000, optional judge-thinking flag with tests), and ship demo fixes with npm test passing

sample_mode: SAMPLE_MODE=true runs the full logic offline with no keys
